_help: Fill each field from MT5: long-press the symbol > Specification. Leave null if unknown. spread is in PRICE units (e.g. 0.25 for gold), commission_per_lot is the round-turn cost in account currency. product_type: spot_cfd, futures_cfd, crypto_cfd, index_cfd or other, exactly as the broker describes it.
